_comment: Copy to rippleuat.local.json (git-ignored) and adjust. Secrets come from environment variables via ${env:NAME}. Message formats follow the WS Taker API docs (docs.liquidity.ripple.com).

run._priceMode_comment: config = instruments[].limitPrice; book = from the live market-data book at send time (IOC/FOK cross by aggressiveBps, GTC rests passiveBps away). Pre-exec orders never use limitPrice: instruments[].preExecPrice if set, else the live touch +/- preExecBps, refused if further than preExecMaxDeviationBps from the touch.
run._sendPriceOnMarket_comment: the API marks price as required: MARKET orders carry the touch (else limitPrice)

instruments._comment: Fixed prices: must be marketable for FOK/IOC to fill (BUY above the ask, SELL below the bid).
Prices taken from the live book.

_orderTypes_comment: Available: MARKET_IOC, MARKET_FOK, LIMIT_IOC, LIMIT_FOK, LIMIT_GTC (wire tif GOOD_TILL_CANCEL), LIMIT_GTD. The trade session documents IOC/FOK; GTC only where the acceptor enables it.
_preExec_comment: These types are ALSO sent as pre-execution orders ("preExec": true). Pre-exec orders execute at the price sent - keep it near market.
_orderVars_comment: Optional order fields from the API docs; null drops the field.
_expect_comment: Statuses that count as PASS per scenario: <TYPE>, <TYPE>+PREEXEC, PREEXEC, or default. Without an entry: FILLED, PARTIAL_FILL, CANCELED, RESTING, EXPIRED.

ws._comment: server = the API server identifier (e.g. TRIPPLEWSAPIUAT1; the wsapiN number does not map to it). Each session logs on with its own client id.

market._maxBookAgeMs_comment: 0 = off. rippleuat force-snapshots every 10 s (60 s on lcawsrippleb), so use >= 30000 if you enable it.
